summary: SSD replacement causes SCEP device-certificate enrollment failures when repair bench proxy is in path
description:
Issue summary: After SSD replacements performed during the standard repair workflow, devices fail automated device certificate (SCEP) enrollment and do not complete Intune/Autopilot provisioning. Impact: Repaired devices require manual intervention (local admin action or offline cert enrollment) and cannot join Azure AD or apply compliance policies. Environment: repair bench network uses corporate proxy with PAC; affected image is Windows 11 22H2 corporate build applied after SSD swap.

Observed behavior: Enrollment stalls on 'Applying device configuration' or fails with SCEP errors in device logs. CA side shows incomplete SCEP challenge/response sequences for affected attempts.
steps_to_reproduce: Perform SSD replacement and restore corporate image via repair bench process
Boot device into OOBE/Autopilot and connect to repair bench network (uses PAC/HTTP proxy)
Allow Intune/Autopilot to progress; observe SCEP enrollment step
SCEP client logs show HTTP 407 or persistent timeouts; device does not receive machine certificate
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: proxy returns HTTP 407 for SCEP POSTs because it requires authentication for the repair subnet; SCEP client cannot present machine credentials prior to obtaining a device cert.
Packet capture shows SCEP POST to https://ca.internal.example/SCEP met with immediate 407 from proxy. When proxy bypassed, SCEP completes normally.
Network team confirmed PAC file contains a legacy rule that routes the repair bench subnet through the proxy rather than DIRECT for the CA FQDN.
Endpoint team reproduced the failure by assigning a repair-bench IP to a test VM and saw identical SCEP 407s.
Workaround tested: update PAC to return DIRECT for CA host for repair subnet; devices then completed enrollment and received machine certs.
Impact estimate: repair bench reported ~8 of 10 devices affected during the morning shift; manual remediation takes ~10-15 minutes per device.
Intune shows devices assigned Autopilot profile but missing device certificate which blocks compliance/policy application and conditional access.
comments: Sofia M. (Support) 2026-03-10: Device fails SCEP enrollment after SSD RMA; logs show HTTP 407. Requesting network team confirm proxy behavior.

Jordan Patel (Network) 2026-03-10: Confirmed proxy requires auth for outbound POSTs from repair subnet; PAC returns proxy for that range due to legacy rule. We'll update PAC to return DIRECT for CA host as an interim measure.

Ethan Chen (Endpoint Eng) 2026-03-11: Verified bypassing proxy fixes enrollment. Propose updating repair bench DHCP options to include WPAD override or static route. Also recommend implementing certificate pre-staging for repaired devices in Intune.
Elena Park (Repair Tech Lead) 2026-03-11: Repair techs reported ~8/10 devices impacted today; manual fix workflow is slowing throughput. Please prioritize PAC change.
Sofia M. 2026-03-11: PAC override applied by network at 09:45 PT; verified SCEP success on a sample of 20 devices. Monitoring for regressions.
resolution: Temporary workaround: Network updated PAC to return DIRECT for the CA FQDN from the repair bench subnet (rolled 2026-03-11 09:45 PT). After the change, re-provisioned devices successfully completed SCEP and received machine certificates. Long-term remediation: network to implement static route or proxy allowlist for CA servers from repair VLAN and Endpoint team to implement pre-staging of device certificates for RMA workflow via Intune automation.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied in prod and validated - SCEP enrollment succeeded for the sampled devices.
Follow-up ticket INT-9281 created to automate pre-staging of device certs for RMA workflow.
Recommend adding SCEP endpoints to proxy allowlist and adding monitoring alert for spike in SCEP failures.
Update repair runbook to include proxy check and quick bypass steps prior to imaging.
follow_up_tasks: INT-9281 - Automate pre-staging of device certs for RMA workflow
INT-9282 - Network: add static route and proxy allowlist for CA servers from repair VLAN
IT-Runbook-Update - Update imaging/repair runbook to include proxy verification and pre-staging steps
